verdict.rationale: Wally Cloud docs say cloud models run on RunAnywhere's hardware rather than the user's, so users can run models too large for a laptop with the same tools. A `--cloud` flag selects the hosted model, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint is available, and browser sign-in and usage tracking support the hosted tier. Hosted execution is an explicit user choice rather than automatic offload, which fits the story's user-initiated framing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that no local model download occurs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the cloud tier.
